label: prf:toffoli-lp-stability
title: Proof of toffoli lp stability
html:
Proof. Proof of toffoli lp stability

Proof. The Gram matrix G over H_3(q) has a characteristic polynomial whose eigenvalue crossings are controlled by the discriminant of the Hecke relation (T - q)(T + q^{-1}) = 0. The smallest eigenvalue \lambda_{\min}(\mathrm{G}(q)) is continuous in q. In the computed witness scan, it remains negative throughout the sampled domain — but that scan is the naive-length-rule matrix under the excised convention (see the open note below), so its sign is not yet a statement about the production form. On the bilinear pairing \mathrm{tr}_M(b_i b_j) the corrected form does carry one negative eigenvalue, \lambda_{\min}(q_0) = -0.75270211 under convention D; on the star pairing \mathrm{tr}_M(b_i b_j^*) it is positive semidefinite, (5,0,1). Any sign claim here must name which pairing it means.

Write T_q in the NF basis. The target-flip amplitude P_{7,6}(q) determines the off-diagonal mass component. The diagonal P_{7,7}(q) determines the Wedderburn weight of the standard channel (Toffoli transfer matrix). Positivity of G\vec{t}(q) therefore reduces to the positivity of the product P_{7,7}(q) \cdot W_{\mathrm{std}}(q) with the appropriate sign from the off-diagonal amplitude.

Open (2026-08-30) — the reduction's second half is underived. The identification P_{7,6}(q) = \Phi(q) is withdrawn: \Phi is not in the image of the Toffoli construction under any indexing or convention, and the derived off-diagonal amplitude is

  P_{7,6}(q) \;=\; -\frac{(q-1)(q+1)(q^6+q^4+2q^2+1)}{2q(q^2+1)^2}

(Toffoli transfer matrix). Separately, the reduction above is asserted in a single clause and the part that now carries the weight — "with the appropriate sign from" the off-diagonal amplitude — is not derived anywhere in the corpus: nothing states what that sign must be, or why. The first factor is unaffected and survives, P_{7,7}(q)\,W_{\mathrm{std}}(q) > 0 for all q > 0; the second is open.

Solving P_{7,7}(q) = 0 on (0,\infty): the numerator is q^3(q^4+1), whose only real zero is q = 0, so the derived diagonal has no positive zero. The golden-ratio threshold q_\star = 1/\varphi^2 = (3-\sqrt5)/2 \approx 0.382 is the root of the convention-C diagonal (q + q^{1/2} - 1)/(q+1) — obtained from x^2 + x - 1 = 0 at x = q^{1/2} — and is a property of the excised frame.

Solving P_{7,6}(q) = 0 on (0,\infty): the factor (q-1) gives q = 1; the factor (q+1) has no positive root; and q^6 + q^4 + 2q^2 + 1 > 0 for every real q. So q = 1 is the only positive zero. The threshold q_\Phi \approx 0.4656 was the root of the retired \Phi's cubic factor (q^{3/2} + q^{1/2} - 1), and no longer corresponds to a zero of any amplitude the construction produces.

For q > 1: P_{7,7}(q) > 0 but P_{7,6}(q) < 0, since the sextic factor is positive and the sign is carried by -(q-1)(q+1). The Wedderburn weights W_{\mathrm{sym}} = W_{\mathrm{alt}} = q^2/(q^4 + 4q^2 + 1) and W_{\mathrm{std}} = (q^2+1)^2/(q^4 + 4q^2 + 1) are strictly positive. So the sign pattern on the physical regime is mixed, not uniformly positive, and the sentence this paragraph used to close with — "all amplitudes of the correct sign" — does not hold for the derived family. Whether feasibility survives a mixed pattern is exactly the open step above; it is not settled here in either direction.

For 0 < q < 1: P_{7,6}(q) > 0. The sign reversal of the off-diagonal amplitude happens at q = 1 and nowhere else, so the earlier statement locating it at q_\Phi \approx 0.466 — and the consequent claim that the gate fails CCNOT semantics on (q_\Phi, 1) — is withdrawn along with \Phi.

The boundedness of shadow prices follows from LP duality (LP-dual stability). The dual norm |y^*| is bounded by the primal norm times the Gram condition number \kappa(\mathrm{G}(q)) = \lambda_{\max}(G)/|\lambda_{\min}(G)|. Open (2026-08-09). The finiteness step is withdrawn pending regeneration. The witness values previously quoted here, \kappa(G(q_0)) \approx 3.03 and \lambda_{\min}(G(q_0)) \approx -0.956, belong to a Gram matrix built with the retracted naive length rule \mathrm{tr}_M(T_w) = z^{\ell(w)} under the excised convention C at a superseded q_0; they match no convention in the registry. Under the production convention D the form is singular, so the ratio \lambda_{\max}/|\lambda_{\min}| is not a condition number and the duality bound does not close on the full NF span. What the proof still stands on is one positivity, not two: P_{7,7}(q_0) \approx 0.6912 > 0 under convention D. Its companion is gone — \Phi is retired, and the derived P_{7,6}(q_0) \approx -0.1438 is negative. Nor is either positivity convention-independent: the convention-C diagonal vanishes at q_\star while the convention-D diagonal has no positive zero at all, so the two frames disagree about the very sign structure this step invokes. The shadow-price bound awaits the radical-quotient ruling; the amplitude step awaits the reduction's open half. \square

Physical consequence. The substrate parameter q_0 \approx 1.110 sits on the q > 1 side of the single derived threshold, where the diagonal amplitudes are positive and the off-diagonal ones negative. The consequences previously drawn here — that the q-GoL (q-Game of Life) is thereby well-defined and information-preserving, and that a substrate with q < q_\star could support no universal reversible computation — both rest on the withdrawn threshold q_\star and on the uniform-positivity step, so neither is carried by this proof as it now stands. They are neither asserted nor refuted here.

Witness: toffoli-lp-stability.witness.json evaluates P_{7,7}(q), \Phi(q), and the Gram spectrum \{\lambda_i(\mathrm{G}(q))\} on the grid q \in \{0.30, 0.35, q_\star, 0.45, 0.60, 0.80, 0.95, 1.00, 1.05, q_0, 1.25, 1.50, 2.00, 3.00\}. Those three confirmations — P_{7,7}(q_\star) = 0, a q-AND zero between q = 0.45 and q = 0.60, and both amplitudes strictly positive at q_0 — belong to the pre-2026-08-30 convention-C producer and are not properties of the derived family: the convention-D diagonal has no positive zero, the only off-diagonal zero is at q = 1, and P_{7,6}(q_0) < 0. The witness has not been regenerated; per item 3 of the proposition the producer needs its Gram trace rule and precision fixed before it can be re-run, so the file on disk should be read as a record of the excised frame.
